arrival_nodes.line: click on a screen pixel: per start (y, z) the arrival Node's (dy, dz) against the control's

c_nodes.derivation: DESIGN.md section 4 (the Nodes' own conversion, record 872 (e)); the lever arm's factor C_nodes / C_ring stated before the run

c_ring.kind: COMPUTATION through the stated lever-arm factor
